faq: Can you build the store if I have nothing yet?

Yes. Tick the box in the order form, give us a store name and tell us what you will sell. We create the store in your own Shopify account and hand it over ready to sell. You can change the name later.
Can you connect my own domain?

Yes. If you already own a domain, we connect it to the new store and set up the redirect from the default Shopify address. If you do not have one yet, we tell you where to buy one and connect it afterwards.

desc:
A Shopify store built from scratch is the foundation of everything you sell online: a fast, trustworthy storefront that turns visitors into paying customers. Ecom Swift LLC builds complete Shopify stores in your own account, from theme and products to payments, shipping, tax and core pages, so the store is ready for its first order.

## Why a well-built Shopify store matters

Your store is your shop window, your sales assistant and your brand in one place. Shoppers decide within seconds whether a store looks credible, and they cannot ask anyone for help, so the pages have to answer every question on their own. A store that loads slowly, hides its shipping costs or looks unfinished loses visitors before they ever see a product. A store that feels clear and professional gives people the confidence to enter their card details.

Building the store properly from the start also saves money later. Messy collections, duplicate apps, oversized images and inconsistent product data are expensive to untangle once orders are coming in. Setting up the structure correctly on day one keeps the store fast, easy to manage and ready to grow.

## How store design and build quality affect conversions

Conversion rate is the share of visitors who buy, and it is shaped by many small decisions. Clear product photos, honest descriptions, visible prices, simple navigation and a short path to checkout all remove reasons to leave. Mobile matters most: most shoppers browse on a phone, so every page must be easy to read, tap and scroll with one thumb.

Speed is part of design. Heavy images and too many apps slow pages down, and slow pages lose shoppers. Trust is part of design too: visible shipping, returns and contact details, real policies and a consistent look tell visitors that a real business stands behind the store. Each of these details can only help you if it is set up correctly in the first place.

## What a great Shopify store should include

- A clean, branded theme with your logo, colors and fonts applied consistently.
- Product pages with sharp images, clear titles, accurate variants, prices and short, useful descriptions.
- Logical collections and navigation so shoppers can find what they want in two or three clicks.
- Payments, shipping rates and tax settings that match where you sell.
- Core pages: home, product, collection, contact, and policy pages for shipping, returns and privacy.
- Search titles and descriptions written for Google, so the store can be found.
- A mobile-first layout that has been checked on a real phone before launch.
- Analytics and email basics, so you can see what is working and follow up with customers.

## What we build for you

We create or open the store in your own Shopify account, so you own everything from the first day. We set up the theme with your branding, add your products with images and variants, connect payments, shipping and tax, create the core pages and write the search titles. Depending on the package, we also add custom home page sections, set up apps, install welcome and abandoned-cart emails, and connect analytics and ad tracking. Before launch you receive a private preview link, a launch checklist and a short handover so you know how to run the store yourself.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Keep the design simple and let your products lead.
- Use one consistent set of fonts and colors across every page.
- Show shipping, returns and contact details clearly.
- Compress images and keep the number of apps small.
- Test the full checkout on your phone before you announce the store.

**Avoid:**
- Crowding the home page with banners, pop-ups and moving elements.
- Installing an app for every small feature.
- Copying manufacturer descriptions word for word, which hurts search ranking.
- Hiding extra fees until the last step of checkout.
- Launching without testing payments, shipping and tax on real orders.

## Who this service is for

This service suits new brands launching their first store, existing sellers moving to Shopify who want a clean start, and dropshippers who need a professional storefront around a supplier catalog. You can start with nothing but an idea and a list of products. You pay Shopify and any app makers directly, and our price covers the work only.

## What we need from you

A short brief about what you sell, your logo and brand colors if you have them, your products or supplier details, and access for us as a collaborator or staff user. Please never send your password. We reply with a short checklist after you order and keep you updated until the store is live.
